name: Government & Public Affairs
short_description: Live stream of Akakū Channel 53 — Maui County Council, boards and commissions, gavel to gavel.
long_description: Akakū Maui Community Media's Government & Public Affairs channel (Spectrum 53), carrying live and recorded Maui County Council meetings, Planning Commission hearings, boards and commissions, and other civic programming. 24-hour live simulcast of the cable broadcast.
